executive_summary: The scan of http://127.0.0.1:3000 produced 13 finding(s): 1 critical, 3 high, 3 medium, 3 low, 3 informational. Overall risk is rated Critical. The most urgent items are: SQL injection in product search, Cross-site scripting in search box, Sensitive path exposed: /ftp, Sensitive path exposed: /ftp, Missing Content-Security-Policy header. 2 of 9 tools did not run: nikto (not installed), sqlmap (disabled). Results may be incomplete, and some issue types were not tested.

findings.name: SQL injection in product search
findings.evidence: Payload ')) UNION SELECT id,email,password FROM Users-- returned 5 rows where 1 was expected.
findings.summary: The site may let an attacker send database commands through a normal input field.
findings.mitigation: Use parameterised queries, never build SQL by joining text, and re-test the affected form.
findings.technical_note: Payload ')) UNION SELECT id,email,password FROM Users-- returned 5 rows where 1 was expected.

findings.name: Cross-site scripting in search box
findings.evidence: <script>alert(document.cookie)</script> was reflected unencoded in the results page.
findings.summary: An attacker could slip their own script into a page and run it in a visitor's browser.
findings.mitigation: Encode all output for its context, validate input, and add a strict Content-Security-Policy.
findings.technical_note: <script>alert(document.cookie)</script> was reflected unencoded in the results page.

findings.name: Outdated jQuery version detected
findings.evidence: jquery-2.2.4.min.js matched CVE-2020-11022 (prototype pollution in jQuery before 3.5.0).
findings.summary: The software or its version is visible and may be out of date.
findings.mitigation: Update the component to a supported release and hide version banners where possible.
findings.technical_note: jquery-2.2.4.min.js matched CVE-2020-11022 (prototype pollution in jQuery before 3.5.0).

findings.name: Missing Content-Security-Policy header
findings.evidence: Response headers did not include Content-Security-Policy.
findings.summary: The site is missing a browser safety header, so some common attacks have less protection.
findings.mitigation: Set the missing response headers at the web server or reverse proxy and confirm with a header check.
findings.technical_note: Response headers did not include Content-Security-Policy.

findings.name: Missing X-Frame-Options header
findings.evidence: Response headers did not include X-Frame-Options or a frame-ancestors directive.
findings.summary: The site is missing a browser safety header, so some common attacks have less protection.
findings.mitigation: Set the missing response headers at the web server or reverse proxy and confirm with a header check.
findings.technical_note: Response headers did not include X-Frame-Options or a frame-ancestors directive.

findings.name: Session cookie without HttpOnly flag
findings.evidence: Set-Cookie: connect.sid=...; Path=/ (no HttpOnly, no SameSite).
findings.summary: A session cookie is not fully protected, so a script or another site may be able to reach it.
findings.mitigation: Set HttpOnly and SameSite on session cookies and mark them Secure when served over HTTPS.
findings.technical_note: Set-Cookie: connect.sid=...; Path=/ (no HttpOnly, no SameSite).

findings.name: Sensitive path exposed: /ftp
findings.evidence: HTTP 200, directory listing enabled, file achat.md and package.json exposed.
findings.summary: A path on the site is open to the public that is usually kept private.
findings.mitigation: Block the path at the server, remove the files, or move them behind authentication.
